notes: Individual observed front openings traced from the original wheel; visible rear barrel bands inside a single opening are united with the same opening.
Ten individually outlined elongated spoke openings and ten inter-spoke voids include visible white rear-barrel sections; white barrel pixels never become a solid front plate.
Full-rim trace ellipse retains outer bridges and avoids cropping the relief near the perimeter.
Small polished recessed rim pockets with an opaque metallic floor are kept solid instead of inventing through holes.
Depth and unseen rear construction remain approximate; this is an image reconstruction, not manufacturing CAD.
The isolated outer-rim reflection next to the left middle opening is clipped from that opening; the full circular rim remains connected.

visualReview.observedFace: Ten sculpted petal spokes with ten long oval openings and ten radial windows; blind perimeter pockets and a large center medallion.
